title: Verify worker access to the checked-in teaching source
text: The maintained source is checked into the public Yoke repository. Workers read docs/teaching from a checkout or the public repository at an exact commit. Yoke items update affected records while planning and finishing; Platform items request linked Yoke updates.
detail: Source publication and the access recipe are present in docs/teaching/README.md, and build.py loads the repository model. This source review proves the Yoke checkout access path, but does not prove actual Platform worker access across machines. Keep that worker-access proof open; local HTML and repository publication alone do not establish it.
